summary: OpenAI has launched Daybreak for Frontline Defenders, a $1 billion initiative aimed at enhancing cyber security for essential services, which will provide advanced AI tools and training to protect critical infrastructure. Similarly, Google's Fairwind Program offers proactive cyber defense tools to governments and trusted partners, strengthening security measures across public and private sectors. These initiatives reflect a significant commitment to improving cybersecurity in an increasingly digital world, highlighting the importance of AI in safeguarding vital services and infrastructure.

items.original: Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model
items.rewritten: Google DeepMind has unveiled WeatherNext 3, which is their latest and most precise AI model for predicting global weather. This model is designed to enhance the accuracy of weather forecasts.

items.original: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models. What if pathology foundation models could do more with less? GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash cut computational demands while maintaining strong performance, opening the door to larger studies and broader exploration. The post GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has developed GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, two advanced models aimed at improving pathology research efficiency. These models reduce computational requirements while still delivering strong results, enabling larger studies and broader research opportunities.

items.original: Proactive cyber defense for governments and enterprises. The Fairwind Program is a limited access program for governments and trusted partners to use our cyber defense tools.

items.original: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra. Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.
items.rewritten: Legora utilized GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in just minutes, successfully identifying all four embedded errors. This process improved their performance by nearly 40% in financial review tasks.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that allows users to create images using a diffusion model, all contained within a single PDF file. This means you can generate and share images easily without needing additional software. It's a convenient way to work with image generation directly in a familiar format.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool designed to enhance the context management of large language models (LLMs) through a manual transmission approach. This allows users to have more control over how context is handled during interactions with LLMs. It aims to improve the overall user experience by making context management more intuitive.
